svg.title: The Maverick Method
svg.desc: Nine stages in four phases: plan, build, prove and ship. Each stage runs a skill in the AI agent, writes one artifact, exits through a CLI gate and has a human checkpoint.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
Inter, Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: From one sentence to a merge-ready pull request

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: Every stage is a skill in your AI agent. Every exit is a CLI gate. Every decision belongs to a human.
